title: Do They Tell Stories About Islands?

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A storyteller wonders whether distant people tell stories about faraway islands, the way Isolans tell stories about faraway lands.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a storyteller, wonders whether distant people tell stories about faraway islands, the way Isolans tell stories about faraway lands.

choices.label: Tell a Story About Distant Lands.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children imagine distant children listening to tales of a magical island full of laughing fishers.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: An elder wonders whether those stories would be accurate, and decides they probably would not.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A scholar wonders whether there might be many islands, each with its own people.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A child wonders whether any of them might be just like Isola.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The storyteller tells a tale of a land of endless forests, and everyone listens happily.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A child interrupts with so many questions that the story never ends.
